tasks.label: build: make build
tasks.detail: Build dist/ (signed GRUB, shim, menu, manifest) via build/build.sh with scripts/dev-env.sh loaded.

tasks.label: build: verify dist/ (build/verify-dist.sh)
tasks.detail: Check hashes, signatures, SBAT and certificate fingerprints of dist/.

tasks.label: keys: make keys
tasks.detail: Create the local Secure Boot signing key in keys/ (refuses to overwrite an existing key).

tasks.label: test: installer unit tests (make test)
tasks.detail: pytest -q installer/tests with the dev environment loaded.

tasks.label: test: devtools unit tests (pytest devtools/tests)
tasks.detail: bb-dev's own unit tests (fast, no QEMU).

tasks.label: test: all unit tests (installer + devtools)
tasks.detail: Runs both unit-test tasks one after the other.

tasks.label: test: pytest current file
tasks.detail: pytest -q on the file in the editor (installer, devtools or e2e tests).

tasks.label: e2e: full suite (make e2e)
tasks.detail: Every QEMU end-to-end test: BIOS, UEFI, Secure Boot (about 100 s with KVM). Logs: out/e2e/logs/.

tasks.label: e2e: quick, no VM boots (-m 'not slow')
tasks.detail: Unit tests of the e2e harness and static image checks; no QEMU boots.

tasks.label: e2e: smoke boots (BIOS, UEFI, Secure Boot)
tasks.detail: tests/e2e/test_e2e_smoke.py: one boot to the menu per firmware mode.

tasks.label: e2e: by marker…
tasks.detail: pytest -q tests/e2e -m <expression>, e.g. "bios and not secureboot".

tasks.label: image: dev image (bb-dev image --fixtures --debug)
tasks.detail: out/dev/beast-booter-dev.img from dist/, with the e2e fixture ISOs and bb_debug=1 in /beast-booter/config.cfg.

tasks.label: image: dev image, overwrite (… --force)
tasks.detail: Same as the dev image task, replacing an existing out/dev/beast-booter-dev.img.

tasks.label: VM: bios
tasks.detail: bb-dev vm --mode bios (SeaBIOS). This terminal is the serial console (Ctrl-A x quits; GRUB uses serial only with bb_serial=1).

tasks.label: VM: uefi
tasks.detail: bb-dev vm --mode uefi (OVMF, Secure Boot off, persistent vars).

tasks.label: VM: sb
tasks.detail: bb-dev vm --mode sb (Secure Boot, persistent vars: a MokManager enrollment done by hand is kept).

tasks.label: VM: sb-enrolled
tasks.detail: bb-dev vm --mode sb-enrolled (Secure Boot, keys/beast-booter.cer pre-enrolled: straight to the menu).

tasks.label: VM: sb-fresh
tasks.detail: bb-dev vm --mode sb-fresh (Secure Boot, brand-new Microsoft-keys vars every run: shows the MokManager flow).

tasks.label: VM: headless, serial console in this terminal…
tasks.detail: bb-dev vm --display none --serial stdio: the menu appears in the VS Code terminal (Ctrl-A x quits; BIOS needs bb_serial=1).

tasks.label: VM: pick mode, bus, display…
tasks.detail: bb-dev vm with every main option chosen from a list.

tasks.label: VM: wait for gdb
tasks.detail: bb-dev vm --gdb --wait-gdb: QEMU starts paused with a gdb stub on localhost:1234. Then start the 'GRUB (BIOS): attach gdb to QEMU' / 'GRUB (UEFI): attach gdb to QEMU' launch config, or the 'gdb: attach in a terminal' task.

tasks.label: VM: print the QEMU command…
tasks.detail: bb-dev vm --print-cmd: show the exact QEMU command line for a mode and exit.

tasks.label: VM: follow the serial log…
tasks.detail: tail -F out/vm/beast-booter-dev/serial-<mode>.log (written on every boot, also when serial is on stdio).

tasks.label: VM: follow the firmware debug log…
tasks.detail: tail -F out/vm/beast-booter-dev/{ovmf,seabios}-debug.log (needs a VM started with --fw-debug; Ubuntu's OVMF writes nothing there, SeaBIOS does).

tasks.label: menu-sync: once
tasks.detail: Copy edited grub/ files into the dev image's ESP (no make build, no reinstall).

tasks.label: menu-sync: watch (background)
tasks.detail: bb-dev menu-sync --watch: re-sync grub/ into the dev image whenever a file changes. Stop it with the trash icon.

tasks.label: debug-config: show
tasks.detail: Print /beast-booter/config.cfg of the dev image.

tasks.label: debug-config: set…
tasks.detail: bb-dev debug-config --set KEY=VALUE... --show on the dev image (bb_debug bb_dryrun bb_autoboot bb_serial timeout debug pager); several pairs separated by spaces, shell quoting works.

tasks.label: debug-config: clear
tasks.detail: Delete /beast-booter/config.cfg from the dev image (the menu then uses its defaults).

tasks.label: debug-config: print for a real USB stick
tasks.detail: Print a config.cfg with the settings you type, to copy to /beast-booter/config.cfg on a real drive yourself (bb-dev never writes real devices).

tasks.label: gdb: attach in a terminal (bb-dev gdb)
tasks.detail: gdb with GRUB symbols and helpers, attached to a VM started by 'VM: wait for gdb'.

tasks.label: gdb: prepare VS Code session (pc)
tasks.detail: Used by the 'GRUB (BIOS): attach gdb to QEMU' launch config: bb-dev gdb --print-cmd writes out/vm/beast-booter-dev/gdb-pc.gdb (symbols, stub address, helpers) without starting gdb, and kernel.exec is linked next to it.
tasks.command: bin/bb-dev gdb --platform pc --print-cmd && source scripts/dev-env.sh && ln -sfn "$BB_GRUB_PC_DBG_DIR/kernel.exec" out/vm/beast-booter-dev/gdb-pc-kernel.exec

tasks.label: gdb: prepare VS Code session (efi)
tasks.detail: Used by the 'GRUB (UEFI): attach gdb to QEMU' launch config: writes out/vm/beast-booter-dev/gdb-efi.gdb and links the x86_64-efi kernel.exec next to it.
tasks.command: bin/bb-dev gdb --platform efi --print-cmd && source scripts/dev-env.sh && ln -sfn "$BB_GRUB_EFI_DBG_DIR/kernel.exec" out/vm/beast-booter-dev/gdb-efi-kernel.exec

tasks.label: dev: doctor (bb-dev doctor)
tasks.detail: Check the whole dev environment; every WARN/FAIL comes with a one-line fix.

tasks.label: dev: setup (bb-dev setup)
tasks.detail: One-shot, idempotent setup: tools, .venv, keys, build, unit tests, dev image.

tasks.label: dev: setup, minimal (bb-dev setup --minimal)
tasks.detail: Only tools + .venv + build.

tasks.label: dev: write out/dev/vscode.env (Test Explorer environment)
tasks.detail: Writes the dotenv file .vscode/settings.json points python.envFile at, so Test Explorer runs and debugs tests with .tools/bin on PATH and the BB_* variables of scripts/dev-env.sh.
tasks.command: source scripts/dev-env.sh && mkdir -p out/dev && { echo '# Written by the VS Code task "dev: write out/dev/vscode.env". Re-run it after moving the checkout.'; printf 'PATH=%s/.tools/bin:$%s\n' "$BB_ROOT" '{PATH}'; printf 'PYTHONPATH=%s/installer:%s/devtools\n' "$BB_ROOT" "$BB_ROOT"; env | grep '^BB_' | LC_ALL=C sort; } > out/dev/vscode.env && cat out/dev/vscode.env

tasks.label: lint: all (scripts/lint.sh; make lint)
tasks.detail: ruff (Python) + ShellCheck (shell), open-source tools only. Exit status 1 on findings. See docs/CODE_QUALITY.md.

tasks.label: lint: apply ruff's safe fixes (scripts/lint.sh --fix)
tasks.detail: ruff check --fix (safe fixes only, never --unsafe-fixes), then reports what is left; ShellCheck findings are fixed by hand.

tasks.label: lint: shellcheck
tasks.detail: scripts/lint.sh --only shellcheck: ShellCheck (pinned, .shellcheckrc) on every shell script, found by extension and shebang; findings go to the Problems panel.

tasks.label: lint: ruff
tasks.detail: scripts/lint.sh --only ruff: ruff check (from .venv, pinned in requirements-dev.txt; rules in ruff.toml) on all Python code.

tasks.label: sbom: generate + vulnerability scan (sbom-vuln skill)
tasks.detail: sbom-vuln.sh all: pinned tools, CycloneDX + SPDX SBOM from dist/, grype + osv-scanner + boot-chain checks. Report: sbom/VULNERABILITIES.md.

tasks.label: sbom: regenerate SBOM only
tasks.detail: sbom-vuln.sh sbom: sbom/beast-booter.{cdx,spdx}.json + validation.json.

tasks.label: sbom: offline re-scan
tasks.detail: sbom-vuln.sh scan --offline: re-scan with cached vulnerability data only.

inputs.description: Extra bb-dev vm options (e.g. --snapshot --fw-debug --serial pty --reset-vars), may be empty
Firmware mode to debug (GRUB symbols resolve best on bios)
GRUB platform of the VM (bios = pc, any UEFI mode = efi)
pytest marker expression (markers: bios uefi secureboot exfat ntfs selftest slow)
Settings for the real stick's config.cfg (KEY=VALUE, space separated)
KEY=VALUE pairs for /beast-booter/config.cfg, space separated (bb_debug bb_dryrun bb_autoboot bb_serial timeout debug pager)
